discription: A simple pulse wave synth with an ADSR envelope and a low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, 0.5); sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
